sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inquiries
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inquiries WHERE created_at >= '2026-09-01' AND created_at < '2026-10-01'

q: WM-200 의 E4 오류 접수는 몇 건?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inquiries WHERE product_model = 'WM-200' AND code = 'E4'

q: 접수가 가장 많은 제품 모델 3개와 건수
sql: SELECT product_model, COUNT(*) AS n FROM inquiries GROUP BY product_model ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT code FROM inquiries WHERE code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY code ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(resolved) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM inquiries WHERE intent = '고장'
SELECT channel, ROUND(AVG(satisfaction), 2) FROM inquiries GROUP BY channel
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inquiries i JOIN products p ON p.model = i.product_model WHERE p.kind = '건조기'
SELECT p.kind, ROUND(AVG(i.satisfaction), 2) FROM inquiries i JOIN products p ON p.model = i.product_model GROUP BY p.kind

q: 처리 완료된 티켓 중 재방문 비율(%)은?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(revisit) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM tickets WHERE status = 'closed'

q: E4 오류 문의에서 나온 티켓의 재방문 건수는?
sql: SELECT SUM(t.revisit) FROM tickets t JOIN inquiries i ON i.id = t.inquiry_id WHERE i.code = 'E4'
SELECT substr(created_at, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM inquiries GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN handled_by = 'agent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM inquiries

q: 안전 긴급도 문의가 있었던 제품 모델 목록
sql: SELECT DISTINCT product_model FROM inquiries WHERE urgency = 'safety'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE visit_date >= '2026-08-01' AND visit_date < '2026-09-01'

q: 만족도를 응답하지 않은 문의는 몇 건?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inquiries WHERE satisfaction IS NULL
SELECT intent, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(resolved) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM inquiries GROUP BY intent
SELECT product_model FROM inquiries GROUP BY product_model ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(resolved) / COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1

q: 세탁기 제품의 오류 코드별 접수 건수
sql: SELECT i.code, COUNT(*) FROM inquiries i JOIN products p ON p.model = i.product_model WHERE p.kind = '세탁기' AND i.code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.code

q: WM-500 출시일 이후 WM-500 접수 건수
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inquiries i JOIN products p ON p.model = i.product_model WHERE i.product_model = 'WM-500' AND i.created_at >= p.released
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE status = 'open'

q: 전화로 접수된 문의 중 해결되지 않은 비율(%)
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(1 - resolved) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM inquiries WHERE channel = 'phone'

q: 오류 코드가 없는 고장 문의는 몇 건?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inquiries WHERE intent = '고장' AND code IS NULL
SELECT substr(created_at, 1, 10) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM inquiries WHERE created_at >= '2026-09-01' AND created_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY d ORDER BY n DESC, d LIMIT 1
